title: Madrid and Mexico City gain bounded urban-service accounts
summary: Madrid Nuevo Norte, Madrid municipality and Mexico City gain dated accounts of housing, transport, water and public services. Eligible identities reach 74 projects and 41 places; these are not completed-portfolio totals.
evidence_note: Fifteen primary-source records reviewed November 22. Ten relevant HTML bodies and five official indexed-text records support bounded claims. Mexico City direct retrieval failures remain explicit; no live service verification is claimed.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
